title: Spicy Feta Cheese Dip
description: This spicy feta cheese dip is great on pitas, used as a dip, or served alongside souvlaki.
ingredients: 0.25 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
1 pound feta cheese, cut into small cubes

steps.text: Combine olive oil, yogurt, lemon juice, paprika, garlic, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and sugar in a food processor; pulse mixture until smooth. Add a couple of feta cubes at a time, processing between batches until mixture is thick and smooth.
Transfer dip to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

video.description: This Spicy Feta Cheese Dip recipe transforms feta cheese into a tasty dip that’s guaranteed to be the star of your next party. In this video, find out how to make the best feta cheese dip ever by combining garlic, feta cheese, and plain yogurt with olive oil in the food processor. (Yep, it’s really that easy.) For a quick appetizer, serve with wedges of freshly toasted pita bread and a drizzle of Mike’s Hot Honey. Then, just sit back, relax, and enjoy the Mediterranean-inspired flavors of this creamy whipped feta.
